universe.name: Clockwork Glasshouse
universe.why: The script discusses 'warehouses of chips' and 'plumbing'. A retro-futuristic, physical marble-run factory makes abstract digital routing visceral, literal, and prone to physical jamming.
universe.pacing: Starts rhythmic and steady, accelerates into chaotic overload, snaps to a sudden halt, then resolves into smooth flowing calm.
universe.signature_shot: The penguin desperately flapping its short flippers, suspended mid-air trying to reach three massive glowing red iron valves hissing steam.
universe.look_bible: Retro-futuristic tactile diorama of a steampunk data factory. Giant polished brass pipes, thick scratched glass vacuum tubes, heavy bakelite switches. Data is represented by glowing neon-blue glass marbles. Deep warm amber lighting bouncing off the polished brass, contrasted heavily with the cool electric cyan glows from the glass tubes. Macro photography feel, shallow depth of field, tactile brushed metal textures. Stop-motion physical lighting with rich, cinematic directional shadows. Color coding: Cyan means flowing/good, Red means jammed/bad.
universe.penguin_render: Physical miniature model with felt texture. Small round egg-shaped Adelie-type penguin, bottom-heavy. Black head and back, white belly. Big round white eye-rings. Small dark beak with an orange tip. Slightly oversized bright orange feet. Three thin stubborn black feathers sticking up from the top of its head, slightly bent.
universe.music: Rhythmic, ticking clockwork percussion layered with plucky upright bass and cheerful high-frequency xylophone pings.

penguin.arc: Acts as the diligent switchboard operator, gets overwhelmed by the massive morning rush, tries to fly up to unjam the pipes (fails), and ultimately pulls the master reset lever to save the system.

shots.cue: Your favorite AI chatbot just stopped thinking. Mid-sentence.
shots.motion: Camera drifts slowly right as the cyan light abruptly powers down into a dull orange flicker, and the penguin taps the glass.

shots.cue: Here's what's behind the chat box.
shots.motion: Camera pushes in slightly on the dead tube as the penguin leans in to inspect the darkness.

shots.cue: Not one brain. Warehouses of chips, wired together, running the same model.
shots.motion: Camera drifts slowly down from the towering rack to the base manifold where the marbles flow.

shots.cue: Every question you type gets split across many of those chips. They pass numbers back and forth, fast, in perfect step.
shots.motion: Camera tracks right, following the smooth, rhythmic flow of the cyan marbles passing through the pipes.

shots.cue: Now picture the morning rush. Millions of people hit send at once.
shots.motion: Camera tilts up rapidly as the massive avalanche of marbles crashes down the main chute.
shots.sfx: Heavy rushing rumble of thousands of glass marbles.

shots.cue: The system tries to spread the load. Spin up more machines. Shuffle traffic between them.
shots.motion: Camera pushes in sharply as the penguin pulls the levers and the massive gear suddenly jams, turning the lighting red.

shots.cue: But these clusters are tightly coupled. One slow link, one bad update, and the whole line waits.
shots.motion: Camera tilts down from the jammed glass pipes to reveal the heavy, vibrating iron plumbing below.
shots.sfx: Heavy low-frequency grinding metal and buzzing.

shots.cue: Twist: it often isn't the chips. Many outages trace back to the plumbing around them. Routing, settings, the software deciding who goes where.
shots.motion: Camera tracks right along the dirty iron pipes, settling on the three massive hissing valves.

shots.cue: Claude.ai, Claude Code and the developer API can share a lot of that plumbing. So during one incident, all three threw errors at once.
shots.motion: Camera drifts slowly left as the penguin leaps and frantically tries to fly up to the valves.

shots.cue: So engineers reroute, roll back, restart.
shots.motion: Camera dips down quickly, following the penguin as it crashes onto the lower pipe.
Camera pushes in on the blueprint as the green bypass route solidifies.
Camera pans right, following the glowing green bypass line.

shots.cue: And your chatbot finishes its sentence.
shots.motion: Camera pulls back slightly as the lever engages and the lighting shifts from angry red back to cool cyan.
shots.sfx: Heavy metallic clunk followed by a smooth power-up hum.

shots.motion: Camera tilts up to rest perfectly on the single glowing vacuum tube, matching the peaceful feeling of the opening.
